name: primeError_eq_sum
summary: The truncated sum up to z equals the positive-part sum up to A ≥ z.

steps.claim: Unfold R_{d,M}(z) = ∑_{ν≤z} λ(ν)/ν − z^(−1)∑_{ν≤z} λ(ν) − log z/φ(M) − Re G_{d,M}(1). The two sums agree term by term: for ν ≤ ⌊z⌋ (≤ A), λ(ν)(A/ν − A/z)⁺/A = λ(ν)(1/ν − 1/z); for ⌊z⌋ < ν ≤ A, ν > z and (A/ν − A/z)⁺ = 0.
steps.lean:
simp [primeError, lambdaSum, sum_div, ← sum_sub_distrib]; apply sum_congr_of_eq_on_inter <;>
    simp +contextual [le_floor_iff u.le, field] <;> rify <;> grind
